The fault is in [parse.py](/app/openlibrary/catalog/marc/parse.py:382). `read_author_person` has no record or tag argument, so it cannot find linked `880` fields or populate `alternate_names`. It also lacks the requested `name_from_list` helper and currently applies different cleanup rules to name parts.

The call paths need attention too: [read_authors](/app/openlibrary/catalog/marc/parse.py:434) reads `100` but not `700` or `720`; [read_contributions](/app/openlibrary/catalog/marc/parse.py:567) can promote `700` and `720` entries to authors, but calls the parser without linkage context. Existing binary fixtures contain linked `700`/`880` names. [Binary linkage lookup](/app/openlibrary/catalog/marc/marc_binary.py:194) returns only one match, and XML records have no corresponding lookup method, so support for multiple matches and XML remains uncertain.

The existing `100` name and date unit test passes; it does not cover alternate names. I recorded the diagnosis in the checkpoint file. No project source or tests were changed.

Implemented alternate-script author imports in [parse.py](/app/openlibrary/catalog/marc/parse.py). Personal authors from 100 and promoted 700/720 fields now use normalized names and collect deduplicated names from linked 880 fields. I added linkage tests and updated affected binary expectations.

The MARC test suite passes: **122 tests**.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [name_from_list](/app/openlibrary/catalog/marc/parse.py:383) calls `strip_foc` before removing a terminal period. For a MARC 100 name of `Smith [from old catalog].`, `read_author_person` stores `Smith [from old catalog` in both `name` and `personal_name`. The new interface requires the marker to be removed. Strip terminal punctuation before the marker, or make marker removal accept the period.

**Tests run:** `pytest -q openlibrary/catalog/marc/tests/test_parse.py` — 61 passed; `pytest -q openlibrary/catalog/marc/tests` — 122 passed. No TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM.

Fixed the reviewed MARC author normalization defect: `Smith [from old catalog].` now becomes `Smith` in both `name` and `personal_name`, while periods in other name parts are preserved. Added regression coverage.

Both reviewer flagged commands passed: 61 tests in `test_parse.py` and 122 tests across the MARC test directory. `git diff --check` also passed.
